650 W × 0.72 = 468 kWh a month, so under 12¢ you're around $47 or less. At $799 the 40T is our best value per TH, and every ten minutes it's drawing for a full block — you keep the machine either way.

Is this your first miner?

Then you know the drill. At under 12¢, the 40T stacks sats to your own wallet for about $47 a month in power, and it's the cheapest per TH we sell — 40 TH/s for $799, Batch 6, ships November 21, 2026.

What are you running now?

So you're at roughly 12 TH/s across the three. One 40T more than triples your total block odds in a single box, and it's cheaper per TH than anything you already own.
